3.speaker: Lucita Azaro
3.text: "Now. Have you played 'Facts or Fiction' before?"

4.speaker: Player_Romus
4.text: "Yes. No need to explain the rules."

6.speaker: Player_Romus
6.text: "Sure, but could you go over the rules again?"

7.speaker: Lucita Azaro
7.text: "It's simple. You tell us three statements about yourself. Two of them have to be true, and one must be a lie."

9.speaker: Narrator
9.text: She gestured to Pabel, who quickly topped up her wine glass.

10.speaker: Lucita Azaro
10.text: "Each of us then guesses which statement is false. If we guess wrong, we have to drink."

11.speaker: Lucita Azaro
11.text: "It was just my turn. I'll let His Majesty choose the next player."

12.speaker: Elena Werner
12.text: "I still find this childish. In my day, if people wanted to get drunk, they got drunk."

15.speaker: Elena Werner
15.text: "And I once had to stop Queen Lyza from purchasing a diamond necklace with Rizian treasury money."

16.speaker: Elena Werner
16.text: "My late husband and I once undertook a three-week sailing trip to Galmland and back."

17.speaker: Elena Werner
17.text: "I have an antique coin collection that's worth more than my house."

18.speaker: Player_Romus
18.text: "There's no way your coin collection is worth that much."

20.speaker: Player_Romus
20.text: "My grandmother never would have tried to embezzle from the treasury."

21.speaker: Pabel Adria
21.text: "I agree. Lyza the Great was beyond those shenanigans."

28.speaker: Pabel Adria
28.text: "I call foul on the Lyza story. Her Majesty was beyond such shenanigans."

29.speaker: Lucita Azaro
29.text: "I can believe Her Majesty Queen Lyza would attempt such a purchase. But not that you would stop it, Ms. Werner."

30.speaker: Narrator
30.text: Laurento grinned and shook his head.

31.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
31.text: "This is too easy. If there's one thing you hated more than sailing, it was your dearly departed husband."

34.speaker: Narrator
34.text: Lucita and Pabel picked up their glasses. Each took a healthy sip.

48.speaker: Player_Romus
48.text: "You've got a fortune in antique coins, do you?"

49.speaker: Player_Romus
49.text: "So my grandmother wasn't such a saint after all."

50.speaker: Elena Werner
50.text: "To be fair, this was towards the end of her life. I think her mind was going."

51.speaker: Elena Werner
51.text: "Ask me anything about Markian ducats and Rezenid medallions."

58.speaker: Player_Romus
58.text: "Since I missed your story, I think you should take another turn, Duchess Azaro."

59.speaker: Player_Romus
59.text: "I'll give it a go myself, if you don't mind."

60.speaker: Narrator
60.text: My councilors looked at each other with no small amount of excitement.

64.speaker: Narrator
64.text: I could feel my head spinning. I racked my brain for ideas.

65.speaker: Narrator
65.text: I felt tired, but not drunk. I racked my brain for ideas.

66.speaker: Player_Romus
66.text: [Lie] "I won the Porte Drazon Derby while disguised as a commoner."

70.speaker: Player_Romus
70.text: "I have a scar on my shoulder blade in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

71.speaker: Player_Romus
71.text: "I have a bullet wound on the back of my leg in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

75.speaker: Player_Romus
75.text: "I have a birthmark on my chest in the exact shape of the Pales Administrative District."

80.speaker: Player_Romus
80.text: "I was secretly happy when my father died."

81.speaker: Player_Romus
81.text: "Back when I was the Party Prince, I got so intoxicated that I mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."

88.speaker: Player_Romus
88.text: "I have nightmares that I'll turn out to be a failure like my father."

89.speaker: Player_Romus
89.text: "My great-grandfather King Xavi II never actually had a mustache. I drew one on his royal portrait a long time ago."

90.speaker: Player_Romus
90.text: "If I weren't king, I think I'd like to be a farmer."

95.speaker: Player_Romus
95.text: [Lie] "I can belch the Rizian national anthem."

99.speaker: Narrator
99.text: The others exchanged troubled looks. Laurento cautiously spoke up.

100.speaker: Player_Romus
100.text: "Growing up in Palas Toras, I once mistook a priceless Markian vase for a urinal."

103.speaker: Narrator
103.text: My tablemates looked around at each other. Lucita was the first to speak up.

109.speaker: Narrator
109.text: Lucita gave me a sly smile.

110.speaker: Lucita Azaro
110.text: "Despite my Azaro heritage, I couldn't stand the sight of blood as a child. There was a time when I fainted from pricking my own finger."

111.speaker: Lucita Azaro
111.text: "My cousin Zola confided in me that she despised her husband-to-be, so I falsified evidence that he was having an affair with a commoner. The engagement was broken off at once."

112.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
112.text: "I accidentally shouted 'All Hail the New Queen!' at His Majesty King Valero's coronation."

113.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
113.text: "When I'm in a diplomatic meeting that I know is trivial, I draw caricatures instead of taking notes."

114.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
114.text: "When I was just out of university, I challenged the mayor of Sallabes to a duel."

116.speaker: Lucita Azaro
116.text: "And I have a 'lucky' set of undergarments that I wear to important meetings and military exercises."

117.speaker: Pabel Adria
117.text: "His Majesty once had me weed a patch of stinging nettles for his amusement. Little did he know I rather enjoyed the sensation."

122.speaker: Narrator
122.text: He gave his wine glass a dramatic swirl.

123.speaker: Player_Romus
123.text: "You're not really doodling during meetings, are you?"

125.speaker: Pabel Adria
125.text: "My father once made me weed a patch of stinging nettles as punishment for shirking off on duty. Little did he know I rather enjoyed the sensation."

129.speaker: Player_Romus
129.text: "You despise aggression, Laurento. You wouldn't have instigated a duel."

130.speaker: Player_Romus
130.text: "I was at my father's coronation. I would have heard if anyone shouted 'queen'."

131.speaker: Lucita Azaro
131.text: "He would if it was over a woman. I doubt he'd admit to drawing caricatures at meetings, no matter how unimportant."

132.speaker: Pabel Adria
132.text: "The duel scenario seems the most far-fetched to me."

136.speaker: Lucita Azaro
136.text: "Even if he were, I doubt he'd admit it to you."

137.speaker: Lucita Azaro
137.text: "It's more plausible than a councilor admitting to the King that he's been failing to take notes at meetings."

138.speaker: Elena Werner
138.text: "I've heard the duel story a hundred times, Laurento. You didn't challenge the mayor of Sallabes. It was the Earl of Jales."

139.speaker: Narrator
139.text: Laurento gave her an abashed look.

140.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
140.text: "You know me too well, Ms. Werner."

142.speaker: Player_Romus
142.text: "So you called my father a queen?"

143.speaker: Player_Romus
143.text: "This means you've been treating serious diplomatic matters with frivolity, Mr. Esquibel."

144.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
144.text: "The current-day Countess of Jales. Neither of us had the nerve to shoot, but he won the grand prize in the end."

145.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
145.text: "Unimportant ones only, Your Majesty. I assure you I take my position very seriously."

146.speaker: Player_Romus
146.text: "It's a terrible habit and you will stop it at once."

147.speaker: Player_Romus
147.text: "I don't mind as long as the job gets done."

148.speaker: Narrator
148.text: Lucita drained her glass as Elena, Pabel and I watched.

161.speaker: Narrator
161.text: Lucita drained her glass. Elena watched with a triumphant smirk.

170.speaker: Narrator
170.text: Elena smirked triumphantly. I noted Pabel's look of slight concern.

171.speaker: Narrator
171.text: Laurento gave a sigh of relief. Lucita tapped the side of her glass for attention.

172.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
172.text: "Quite accidentally, Your Majesty. And it was drowned out in the loud chorus of other voices."

175.speaker: Narrator
175.text: She tapped on her glass. Pabel dutifully refilled it.

177.speaker: Narrator
177.text: There was a sudden feeling of tension around the table. Lucita broke it with a tap on her glass.

178.speaker: Narrator
178.text: He looked down at the table.

179.speaker: Pabel Adria
179.text: "In the '20s, I wrote a poem that was selected for the annual Rizian Literary Compendium. Pseudonymously, of course."

181.speaker: Lucita Azaro
181.text: "There's the falsehood. Running a royal household doesn't leave one with time for poetry."

182.speaker: Elena Werner
182.text: "The butler's wine descriptions have verged on poetry at times. I'd prefer to believe he doesn't take perverse pleasure in stinging nettles."

183.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
183.text: "And *I'd* rather not believe the story about the Rumburgian valet. As hilarious as it might have been."

184.speaker: Player_Romus
184.text: "Yes, the pepper story has got to be the lie. Pabel is too professional for such tomfoolery."

185.speaker: Player_Romus
185.text: "I would know if Pabel had written poetry."

189.speaker: Player_Romus
189.text: "Pabel's a great butler, but he's no poet."

190.speaker: Player_Romus
190.text: "You don't like stinging nettles, Pabel. No one does."

192.speaker: Pabel Adria
192.text: "Correct. That was the worst pain I've ever felt in my life."

194.speaker: Pabel Adria
194.text: "And weeding that nettle patch was the worst pain I've ever felt in my life."

195.speaker: Pabel Adria
195.text: "Actually, that isn't a lie. The poor man was sneezing for the rest of the night."

196.speaker: Player_Romus
196.text: "I'm sorry about that. I was a horrible kid."

198.speaker: Narrator
198.text: My butler seemed reluctant to speak. He gave a graceful nod.

202.speaker: Narrator
202.text: My butler gave a graceful nod.

203.speaker: Pabel Adria
203.text: "I once overheard a Rumburgian royal valet make a demeaning comment about Queen Mother Estela during a diplomatic visit. I persuaded our chef to put an excessive amount of pepper in his food at the staff dinner."

209.speaker: Player_Romus
209.text: "It served you right. I remember you had given me an odd look earlier in the day."

210.speaker: Player_Romus
210.text: "Wait. I want to know more about this poem."

211.speaker: Player_Romus
211.text: "You played a dangerous game with Rumburg. What if he'd found out and told Beatrice?"

214.speaker: Pabel Adria
214.text: "He was worried I was distracting you from your princely duties."

221.speaker: Pabel Adria
221.text: "It worked. I always did my chores after that."

222.speaker: Pabel Adria
222.text: "He wouldn't have. I told him that in Rizia, pepper was a luxury reserved for only the most honored guests."

223.speaker: Pabel Adria
223.text: "There's not much to know, Your Majesty. It was many years ago."

234.speaker: Narrator
234.text: She turned to Laurento, and the two clinked glasses and drank. My foreign councilor had a contemplative look as he put his glass down.

235.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
235.text: "I read that compendium regularly. What was your pseudonym?"

238.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
238.text:
"I was the shadow to your light

A silent witness to the burden you bore.

A chasm yawns between us now,

Eager to be filled with talk, with touch."

239.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
239.text:
"Like two rising tides beneath a setting sun,

We are pulled back to each other with a force that knows no bounds.

And just as the velvet embrace of night claims the day's end,

Your fire consumes me, my heart's sov--"

240.speaker: Narrator
240.text: He was interrupted by a sudden clatter coming from Pabel's direction. Everyone turned to look at my butler.

241.speaker: Lucita Azaro
241.text: "Well. Whichever palace maid he wrote that for is one lucky girl."

244.speaker: Narrator
244.text: I was having trouble concentrating. I blurted out the first thing that came to mind.

245.speaker: Player_Romus
245.text: "I wish Rizia would get into a big, bloody war. Just so I can prove myself."

246.speaker: Player_Romus
246.text: "Sometimes I wish the '26 uprising had succeeded."

250.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
250.text: "Intriguing, dear Duchess. But false. Azaros don't fall prey to superstition."

251.speaker: Player_Romus
251.text: "If there's one thing Azaros don't do, it's faint at the sight of blood. That's the lie."

252.speaker: Player_Romus
252.text: "I agree. You don't seem like the 'lucky underwear' type."

253.speaker: Player_Romus
253.text: "I don't believe the story about your cousin."

254.speaker: Elena Werner
254.text: "I'd sooner believe that than the idea of Lucita Azaro fainting at a drop of blood."

255.speaker: Elena Werner
255.text: "Agreed. I'm afraid the Duchess has made this too easy."

259.speaker: Pabel Adria
259.text: "No, the blood story is so implausible that it must be true. I have my doubts about your role in the dissolution of your cousin's engagement."

265.speaker: Lucita Azaro
265.text: "You had it right, Your Majesty. I don't wear lucky underwear on important days."

266.speaker: Lucita Azaro
266.text: "Mr. Esquibel had it right. I don't wear lucky underwear on important days."

279.speaker: Narrator
279.text: Pabel and Elena took sips of their wine. Lucita continued with a mischievous smile on her face.

280.speaker: Narrator
280.text: Elena took a prim sip of her wine. Lucita continued with a mischievous smile on her face.

282.speaker: Lucita Azaro
282.text: "I find it invigorating to wear nothing at all beneath my uniform."

283.speaker: Narrator
283.text: Laurento and Elena shot each other amused looks. Pabel politely coughed.

287.speaker: Narrator
287.text: Laurento and Elena shot each other amused looks. Pabel politely coughed as he poured us refills.

288.speaker: Pabel Adria
288.text: "Perhaps now would be a good time for Duchess Azaro to retire? There's been a great deal of wine flowing tonight."

289.speaker: Lucita Azaro
289.text: "It's all harmless fun, Pabel. Isn't it, Your Majesty?"

290.speaker: Player_Romus
290.text: "Pabel is right. Your conduct this evening has been highly unbecoming of a Duchess."

291.speaker: Player_Romus
291.text: "Yes, we all deserve some reprieve from the stiff formalities of royal life."

292.speaker: Player_Romus
292.text: "The Duchess is a grown woman, Pabel. Don't police her drinking."

294.speaker: Pabel Adria
294.text: "My apologies to you both. I was only trying to be helpful."

296.speaker: Narrator
296.text: Lucita straightened up in her seat. I saw indignance in her eyes.

297.speaker: Lucita Azaro
297.text: "My deepest apologies, Your Majesty. I was under the impression that informality was allowed this evening."

298.speaker: Player_Romus
298.text: "Informality, not indecency. You've crossed a line."

299.speaker: Player_Romus
299.text: "Let's continue. But do try to act with a little more decorum."

302.speaker: Player_Romus
302.text: "I made a mistake. A king shouldn't get too close to his inferiors."

306.speaker: Lucita Azaro
306.text: "I understand. I'll take my leave, then."

307.speaker: Elena Werner
307.text: "I will as well. I told you all, this is a silly game."

308.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
308.text: "Yes, we've had enough confessions for tonight. Until tomorrow, Your Majesty."

309.speaker: Narrator
309.text: My councilors left the table. Pabel helped me to my feet.

310.speaker: Lucita Azaro
310.text: "If you'd like to be helpful, you can fetch us a new bottle. This one's almost empty."

312.speaker: Narrator
312.text: He disappeared to the kitchen and came back with more wine. Lucita looked at me expectantly.

319.speaker: Player_Romus
319.text: "I feel so goddamn lonely all the time."

335.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
335.text: "Of course you loved Princess Lena, Your Majesty. That was the lie."

336.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
336.text: "Of course you were faithful to Princess Lena, Your Majesty. That was the lie."

337.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
337.text: "Of course you weren't glad when King Valero died, Your Majesty. That was the lie."
337.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_NeverLovedWife"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Cheated"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_HatedD"] == true)

341.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
341.text: "Of course you don't consider your father a failure, Your Majesty. That was the lie."
341.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_NeverLovedWife"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Cheated"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_HatedD"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Nightmares"] == true)

342.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
342.text: "Of course you don't want a repeat of the violence of the 1920s, Your Majesty. That was the lie."
342.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_NeverLovedWife"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Cheated"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_HatedD"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Nightmares"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_WantWar"] == true)

343.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
343.text: "Of course you don't wish the uprising had succeeded, Your Majesty. That was the lie."
343.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_NeverLovedWife"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Cheated"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_HatedD"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Nightmares"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_WantWar"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Democratic"] == true)

344.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
344.text: "Of course you're not lonely with your family in the palace, Your Majesty. That was the lie."
344.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_NeverLovedWife"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Cheated"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_HatedD"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Nightmares"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_WantWar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Democratic"] == true) == false)

346.speaker: Player_Romus
346.text: "You guessed it. That was my lie."

347.speaker: Narrator
347.text: The others quickly nodded their assent. I could see Lucita scrutinizing me closely.

351.speaker: Narrator
351.text: The others at the table quickly nodded their assent. I could see Lucita scrutinizing me closely.

352.speaker: Narrator
352.text: The others quickly nodded their assent.

353.speaker: Narrator
353.text: There was a palpable feeling of relief in the air.

354.speaker: Narrator
354.text: There was a palpable feeling of tension in the air. My tablemates consciously avoided looking at me or each other.

355.speaker: Lucita Azaro
355.text: "So... what was the lie, Your Majesty?"

357.speaker: Lucita Azaro
357.text: "You must like wine, Your Majesty. You've been drinking enough of it tonight."

370.speaker: Lucita Azaro
370.text: "This is easy, Your Majesty. You must have kissed women before you married Princess Lena."

371.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
371.text: "The vase story must be a lie. It's too embarrassing."

372.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
372.text: "The mustache story must be a lie."

373.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
373.text: "You can't really belch the Rizian national anthem."

377.speaker: Narrator
377.text: The others nodded their assent. I saw Pabel avert his gaze.

379.speaker: Player_Romus
379.text: "You guessed it. That was my lie."

381.speaker: Elena Werner
381.text: "Don't you remember, Laurento? His Majesty used to be quite the little vandal."

390.speaker: Lucita Azaro
390.text: "The Pales Administrative District? May we see it, Your Majesty?"

393.speaker: Lucita Azaro
393.text: "May we hear the National Anthem, then, Your Majesty?"

394.speaker: Narrator
394.text: I pulled my collar aside and showed her the scar.

401.speaker: Narrator
401.text: I pulled my trouser leg up and showed her the scar.

402.speaker: Narrator
402.text: I unbuttoned the top button of my shirt and showed her the birthmark.

406.speaker: Narrator
406.text: She slowly reached over and ran her fingertips across it.

408.speaker: Elena Werner
408.text: "But the derby story never happened. As talented a horseback rider as His Majesty may be."

409.speaker: Narrator
409.text: Lucita sat back in her chair, disappointed.

410.speaker: Pabel Adria
410.text: "Your Majesty, you have a long day ahead of you tomorrow. Why don't we adjourn?"

412.speaker: Lucita Azaro
412.text: "The Porte Drazon Derby? That must have been a rush."
412.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Scar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Anthem"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Derby"] == true)

414.speaker: Narrator
414.text: I drew in a large breath. Pabel cleared his throat.

415.speaker: Player_Romus
415.text: "Yes, that sounds like a wise idea."

416.speaker: Player_Romus
416.text: "But we were just getting to the good stuff."

420.speaker: Player_Romus
420.text: "No! You can't kill this party! The Party Prince commands you!"

421.speaker: Narrator
421.text: I suddenly became acutely aware of how much wine I'd had to drink. Pabel helped keep me steady as we made our way upstairs to my suite.

423.speaker: Player_Romus
423.text: "Yes, I kissed women. Lots and lots of women. They had breasts and everything."

427.speaker: Narrator
427.text: He swiftly ushered me inside and took off my coat.

435.speaker: Pabel Adria
435.text: "Rom, it was a very long time ago."

436.speaker: Pabel Adria
436.text: "It was a very long time ago, Your Majesty."

439.speaker: Player_Romus
439.text: "It's fine, Pabel. I won't tell a soul."

440.speaker: Player_Romus
440.text: "Please exercise more discretion going forward. I can't have word get out that my butler is a pervert."

441.speaker: Narrator
441.text: Pabel stopped and turned around. He cautiously lifted his eyes to meet mine.

442.speaker: Narrator
442.text: Pabel hurriedly backed away from me.

445.speaker: Narrator
445.text: He rushed out, closing the door behind him.

446.speaker: Narrator
446.text: Relief blossomed across Pabel's face. He bowed.

447.speaker: Pabel Adria
447.text: "I hope you enjoyed your evening, Your Majesty."
447.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Relations_PabelFriend"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Relations_PabelFriend"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGamePabel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Pabel"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_YourMajesty"] == true)

448.speaker: Player_Romus
448.text: "Be honest. Do you still feel that way about me now?"

454.speaker: Player_Romus
454.text: "This isn't right. You've had more to drink than I have."

455.speaker: Narrator
455.text: Instead of replying, he pushed me against the nearest wall and pressed his lips to mine, more forcefully this time.

460.speaker: Pabel Adria
460.text: "You should get some sleep, Your Majesty. It's late."

476.speaker: Player_Romus
476.text: "Yes. Pabel, remind me to call important meetings more often."

478.speaker: Narrator
478.text: The others tittered. Pabel frowned indignantly.

481.speaker: Narrator
481.text: My butler guided me up stairways and through corridors to my suite on the top floor.

486.speaker: Player_Romus
486.text: "I don't share your feelings. But you're still my friend."

488.speaker: Pabel Adria
488.text: "I was reckless to submit it for publication. I... I must have missed you that much."

489.speaker: Player_Romus
489.text: "Nothing can happen between us. It's too dangerous."

494.speaker: Narrator
494.text: It was some time before we broke apart. Pabel stared into my eyes, his breath ragged.

495.speaker: Narrator
495.text: He left the room and gently closed the door behind him.

496.speaker: Player_Romus
496.text: "God. I never felt that with Lena."

498.speaker: Player_Romus
498.text: "Needless to say, I hope this means my secrets are also safe with you."

499.speaker: Player_Romus
499.text: "Nobody can ever know about this. Nobody."

503.speaker: Narrator
503.text: He reached past me and switched off the light.

509.speaker: Narrator
509.text: With some difficulty, I undressed and crawled into bed.

514.speaker: Narrator
514.text: I undressed and got into bed.

515.speaker: Player_Romus
515.text: "I'll help find you a lover more suited to a man of your station."

519.speaker: Player_Romus
519.text: "You are an abomination before the Lord. I cannot keep you on as butler unless you repent."

520.speaker: Narrator
520.text: Pabel hurriedly backed away from me.

522.speaker: Pabel Adria
522.text: "Please, Your Majesty. I think you have the wrong idea."

526.speaker: Narrator
526.text: With some difficulty, I undressed and crawled into bed.

527.speaker: Narrator
527.text: I slept more soundly than I had in months.

529.speaker: Pabel Adria
529.text: "Yes, of course. I was foolish to hope otherwise."

530.speaker: Narrator
530.text: He looked me in the eye and nodded.

532.speaker: Pabel Adria
532.text: "I can do quite well for myself in that department."

533.speaker: Narrator
533.text: I was just starting to drift off to sleep when a soft knock came at the door.

536.speaker: Narrator
536.text: Lucita was standing there, still dressed in the beaded gown she'd worn earlier.

537.speaker: Lucita Azaro
537.text: "Your Majesty, I've just received a message of great importance from Wehlen intelligence. May I come in?"

538.speaker: Narrator
538.text: She gave me a scornful look.

539.speaker: Lucita Azaro
539.text: "I've been drinking men under the table since I was eighteen. It takes more than a little wine to do me in."

544.speaker: Narrator
544.text: Lucita walked into my suite. I followed her in and closed the door.

546.speaker: Narrator
546.text: She gave me a meaningful look.

547.speaker: Player_Romus
547.text: "Put it in my reports. I'll get to it first thing in the morning."

549.speaker: Narrator
549.text: As soon as it had shut, she stepped towards me. There was a look of urgency in her eyes.

550.speaker: Player_Romus
550.text: "I've been wanting to rip that gown off of you all night."

551.speaker: Lucita Azaro
551.text: "I'd prefer if you didn't. It's custom-tailored and worth thousands."

555.speaker: Narrator
555.text: She took a step backwards, suddenly unsure of herself.

560.speaker: Lucita Azaro
560.text: "If anything, I'm taking advantage of you."

568.speaker: Player_Romus
568.text: "So... does this count as an important meeting?"

570.speaker: Lucita Azaro
570.text: "We're alone. Everyone else has passed out. Who's going to say anything?"

571.speaker: Player_Romus
571.text: "I respect you as a councilor, Duchess Azaro. That's all."

572.speaker: Lucita Azaro
572.text: "Why don't you find out for yourself, Your Majesty?"

573.speaker: Narrator
573.text: I undressed and got into bed.

574.speaker: Player_Romus
574.text: "Truth, lies, what does it matter? Everyone's just going to believe what they want to anyway."

575.speaker: Player_Romus
575.text: "You all guessed wrong! Why aren't you drinking?"

576.speaker: Player_Romus
576.text: "Life, Duchess Azaro. Life is a lie."

580.speaker: Lucita Azaro
580.text: "A farmer? It wouldn't be my first choice, that's for sure."
580.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Scar"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Anthem"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Derby"] == true) == false)

581.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
581.text: "Goodnight, Your Majesty. Thank you for an enlightening time."

582.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
582.text: "This elder statesman is going to call it an evening, Your Majesty. Thank you for an enlightening time."

583.speaker: Elena Werner
583.text: "Yes, we all learned a great deal. Possibly too much."

585.speaker: Lucita Azaro
585.text: "The more intimately we know each other, the better we can fight as a team. It's an old army trick."

586.speaker: Narrator
586.text: Lucita and the others quickly drained their glasses.

591.speaker: Paskal Beniwoll
591.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Lucita"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Laurento"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Elena"] == true) == false

594.speaker: Lucita Azaro
594.text: "But you haven't taken a turn yet, Your Majesty."

595.speaker: Player_Romus
595.text: "Fine. If it will make you happy, I'll give it a try."

596.speaker: Player_Romus
596.text: "I'm your king. That's all you need to know about me."

597.speaker: Player_Romus
597.text: "Frankly, I don't think that would be very wise."

598.speaker: Narrator
598.text: Laurento waved his glass in my direction.

599.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
599.text: "His Majesty has spoken. Should we all adjourn?"

600.speaker: Player_Romus
600.text: "That was a lie too. The King's allowed to lie more than once."

601.speaker: Player_Romus
601.text: "It was great. Nobody had any idea it was me."

606.speaker: Narrator
606.text: Laurento uneasily pushed back his chair.

611.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
611.text: "Unbelievable. Functions such as these must be torture for you."

612.speaker: Narrator
612.text: Lucita raised her glass and drank a sip anyway.

613.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
613.text: "Forgive me, but this elder statesman is going to call it an evening. Thank you for an enlightening time."

614.speaker: Elena Werner
614.text: "Yes, we've all learned enough about each other already. Possibly too much."

616.speaker: Lucita Azaro
616.text: "The more intimately we know about each other, the better we can defend each other. It's an old army trick."

617.speaker: Player_Romus
617.text: "The more intimately we know each other, the better we can defend each other."

620.speaker: Player_Romus
620.text: "Your behavior towards me is completely inappropriate. You should be ashamed of yourself."

621.speaker: Narrator
621.text: Her face reddened. I could see her struggling to contain her temper.

630.speaker: Pabel Adria
630.text: "I hope you enjoyed your evening, Rom."
630.conditionsRaw: (Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Relations_PabelFriend"] == true) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Prologue_Relations_PabelFriend"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGamePabel"] == true  and  Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Turn_Pabel"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLC.Relations_Pabel_YourMajesty"] == true) == false)

634.speaker: Player_Romus
634.text: "I didn't make a complete ass of myself, did I?"

636.speaker: Narrator
636.text: Out of the corner of my eye, I saw Pabel give me an uneasy look. Lucita didn't appear to notice.

640.speaker: Player_Romus
640.text: "I did. But none of them compared."

641.speaker: Narrator
641.text: There was an awkward silence for a moment.

645.speaker: Pabel Adria
645.text: "Even if you did, I doubt anyone will remember what was said."

648.speaker: Pabel Adria
648.text: "I was trying to protect you. Your mouth was running as freely as the wine."

649.speaker: Player_Romus
649.text: "I did. I gained some valuable intel."

650.speaker: Pabel Adria
650.text: "I've never learned that much about the councilors in one go."

653.speaker: Narrator
653.text: She guided my hand to the small of her back.

654.speaker: Narrator
654.text: She looked me square in the eye.

655.speaker: Narrator
655.text: She guided my hand to the hem of her dress.

656.speaker: Lucita Azaro
656.text: "And as your war councilor, I need to be able to defend you very, very well."

657.speaker: Narrator
657.text: I reached over her head and turned off the light.

659.speaker: Player_Romus
659.text: "I don't want this to be the way we get together. Let me take you on a proper date."

662.speaker: Narrator
662.text: A look of frustration spread across her face. She nodded.

663.speaker: Lucita Azaro
663.text: "I'm right here. Isn't this more efficient?"

665.speaker: Narrator
665.text: She practically ran out of the room.

667.speaker: Narrator
667.text: She gave a flustered bow and left the room.

668.speaker: Narrator
668.text: I shut the door and got back into bed. I slept more soundly than I had in months.

670.speaker: Narrator
670.text: She turned around and walked back down the hall.

671.speaker: Pabel Adria
671.text: "I have my doubts about that one as well."

678.speaker: Elena Werner
678.text: "But I'm not sure about this Pales Administrative District business."

679.speaker: Elena Werner
679.text: "But wanting to be a farmer? That's not His Majesty's style."

681.speaker: Pabel Adria
681.text: "Shall I escort you to your quarters, Your Majesty?"

685.speaker: Narrator
685.text: My councilors and I said our goodbyes. They dispersed to the rooms they were staying in.

686.speaker: Narrator
686.text: My councilors, Pabel and I said our goodnights. I headed to my suite on the top floor.

693.speaker: Player_Romus
693.text: "It doesn't matter. It's a silly game."

694.speaker: Player_Romus
694.text: "I only *wish* I could belch 'On Shores Of Gold'."

705.speaker: Pabel Adria
705.text: "If I may be so bold, I've seen that for myself. I'll throw my lot in with Duchess Azaro."

706.speaker: Player_Romus
706.text: "I don't really want to be a farmer."

707.speaker: Player_Romus
707.text: "What can I say? I like knowing where my food comes from."

708.speaker: Player_Romus
708.text: "Everything was true! Now everybody has to drink."

727.speaker: Narrator
727.text: Laurento elbowed her in the side. She reluctantly raised her glass.

728.speaker: Lucita Azaro
728.text: "Right you are, Your Majesty. A proso."

736.speaker: Lucita Azaro
736.text: "The vase story must be a lie. It's too embarrassing."
736.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_FirstKiss"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_DontLikeWine"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Vase"] == true)

737.speaker: Lucita Azaro
737.text: "The mustache story must be a lie."
737.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_FirstKiss"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_DontLikeWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Vase"] == true) == false) and (Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Mustache"] == true)

738.speaker: Lucita Azaro
738.text: "You can't really belch the Rizian national anthem."
738.conditionsRaw: ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_FirstKiss"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_DontLikeWine"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Vase"] == true) == false) and ((Variable["RiziaDLCIsolated.Turn04_Winery_DrinkingGame_Confessions_Mustache"] == true) == false)

751.speaker: Narrator
751.text: She reached for her glass. It was empty.

754.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
754.text:
"I envy the flowers, unabashed in their display.

They do not hide their nature, nor fear the light of day.

The fragrance of their open hearts fills the air with dreams,

A scent of possibilities, or so it truly seems."

755.speaker: Laurento Esquibel
755.text:
"Yet here I stand, a silent ghost, amongst the floral cheer,

A figure lost in what could be, held back by hidden fear."

756.speaker: Player_Romus
756.text: "That was beautiful. I had no idea."

758.speaker: Player_Romus
758.text: "That's not serious poetry. One might recite it at a ladies' tea."

759.speaker: Pabel Adria
759.text: "It was a silly habit, Your Majesty. I'm fully focused on running your household now."

760.speaker: Narrator
760.text: Silence descended around our table. Lucita spoke up brightly.

766.speaker: Pabel Adria
766.text: "I-- I think you have the wrong idea. Let's just both forget about all of this."

767.speaker: Player_Romus
767.text: "We both know that I don't. I've spent years atoning for the things we did as boys. You should consider the same."

768.speaker: Player_Romus
768.text: "I admit I have harbored similar feelings. But I have never once acted on them, because I'm a God-fearing man."

769.speaker: Player_Romus
769.text: "I hope I do, Pabel. Let's leave it at that."

771.speaker: Pabel Adria
771.text: "I'm truly sorry, Your Majesty. I should never have brought it up."

772.speaker: Pabel Adria
772.text: "Thank you. I won't mention a word of this going forward."

773.speaker: Player_Romus
773.text: "I care about you as a friend. But I don't share your proclivities."

774.speaker: Narrator
774.text: Pabel took a deep breath. He smoothed his hair back.

775.speaker: Narrator
775.text: A powerful sensation washed over me, like that of finally arriving home after a long, exhausting journey. I took a step back.

776.speaker: Pabel Adria
776.text: "The butler's quarters here are connected by an adjoining door. Just knock if you need me."

777.speaker: Narrator
777.text: Pabel walked over to the side of the room. He paused with his hand on the doorknob.

778.speaker: Player_Romus
778.text: "I'll never forget what we had back then. But it's over."

788.speaker: Narrator
788.text: Pabel took a deep breath. He smoothed his hair back.

789.speaker: Pabel Adria
789.text: "Forgive me, I dropped my wine glass. I'll have it cleared up at once."

790.speaker: Narrator
790.text: He turned away to signal a winery staff member. Silence descended around our table.

798.speaker: Narrator
798.text: I lurched unsteadily to my feet. Pabel rushed to my side and took my arm.

805.speaker: Player_Romus
805.text: "Wait. Your poem. I think I know what it was about."

808.speaker: Player_Romus
808.text: "Whatever secret you may be harboring, it's safe with me."

811.speaker: Player_Romus
811.text: "I have often felt similarly myself. Hiding in the shadows while others bloom."

812.speaker: Pabel Adria
812.text: "You are the king, Your Majesty. You need not fear the sun."

818.speaker: Narrator
818.text: Lucita picked up her glass and took a healthy sip.
